readme_excerpt: Firefly III A free and open source personal finance manager No AI, no cloud and privacy-friendly Visit the demo Read the docs · Download the latest release · Submit a bug · Ask a question · 🙏 Donate Welcome to Firefly III 🥳 "Firefly III" is a (self-hosted) manager for your personal finances.
